knobs.mix: Dry/wet mix. Fully right is all reverb.
knobs.width: Reverb stereo width. 0 % mono, 200 % extra wide.
knobs.char: Converter grit. 0 % clean; 100 % 16-bit with hiss. The era's band limit stays.
knobs.hi: High ratio: treble decay vs mid. Lower is darker.
knobs.lo: Low ratio: bass decay vs mid.
knobs.r1d: 1st reflection delay (centre). Up to 100 ms (era 7), 1 s (era 5).
knobs.dif: Diffusion: how fast the reverb thickens.
knobs.erb: Early reflections vs reverb. 100 % is reflections only.
knobs.smod: Space modulation: slow movement in the tail (era 5).
knobs.glev: Gate threshold: input level that opens it (era 5). 0 is off.
knobs.size: Room size: spreads the early reflections.
knobs.live: Liveness: how reflective the room is. Pan A/B: pan direction.
knobs.dhigh: Delay treble feedback (era 5). Lower is darker.
knobs.edamp: Echo HIGH, 0-10: how much treble each repeat keeps. 10 keeps it all, lower is darker. Era 5 shows it as the REV5's x0.1-1.0.
knobs.mrt: Not used: the reverb flange now decays with the reverb itself (Reverb time).
knobs.mlpf: Mod FX low-pass (era 5). THRU is off.
knobs.duckr: Ducking: how far the reverb dips while you play.
knobs.shift: Pitch shift, semitones. Pitch C: left voice.
knobs.pdel: Delay before the shifted voice. Pitch C: up to 200 ms.
knobs.pfb: Pitch feedback (Pitch A): each repeat shifts again.
knobs.d_loq: Digital EQ: low bandwidth (era 5). As the REV5: 0.1 narrowest, 5.0 widest. Peak bands only.
knobs.d_midq: Digital EQ: mid bandwidth (era 5). As the REV5: 0.1 narrowest, 5.0 widest. Peak bands only.
knobs.d_hiq: Digital EQ: high bandwidth (era 5). As the REV5: 0.1 narrowest, 5.0 widest. Peak bands only.
knobs.shift2: Second voice shift (Pitch B, C). Pitch C: right voice.
knobs.pdel2: Delay before the second voice. Pitch C: up to 200 ms.
knobs.r1ld: Left 1st reflection delay (era 5). Left side only.
knobs.r1rd: Right 1st reflection delay (era 5). Right side only.
knobs.rmix: Rev mix (the REV5's REV MIX): with an FX on, how much reverb is added to the effect. As on the hardware the effect plays at full level and the reverb mixes in: 100 % full reverb, 0 % the effect alone. No effect when FX wet is on.

keys.5: Era 5: the 1987 REV5 sound, more controls.
keys.Store: Save the current settings as a preset.
keys.?: Tooltips on/off. Double-click a knob to reset it.
keys.Pan A: Reflections sweep across (era 5). Liveness sets direction.
keys.Pan B: Reflections sweep across and back (era 5). Liveness sets direction.
keys.RevE/R: The reverb program's own early reflections, the way the hardware's reverb programs play them (the other mode keys are the early-reflection programs' patterns). Era 7: three per channel; era 5: the REV5's multitap; both start at the pre-delay. Each preset picks its own set (hall, plate or room). Room size, liveness and E/R number do not apply.
keys.FX → Rev: FX feeds the reverb. As on the hardware the effect is also heard directly, with the reverb added (Rev mix); FX wet removes it.
keys.Rev → FX: Reverb feeds the FX. As on the hardware the dry signal joins the reverb (Rev mix) into the FX; FX wet sends the reverb alone.
keys.LFOsync: Sync the modulation rate to tempo.
keys.Revflange: Mod: reverb flange, a flange at a fixed 30 % feedback; the reverb gives its decay.
keys.Duckon: Ducker on: dips the reverb while you play.
keys.Wetsolo: Wet solo: reverb only, ignores Mix.
keys.Pitch A: Pitch A: one voice, with feedback.
keys.Pitch C: Pitch C: two voices, one per side.
keys.Peak: Band shape: peak. Click for shelf.
keys.Shelf: Band shape: shelf. Click for peak.
keys.Intparam: Internal parameters. A dot: one is in use.
keys.FXwet: FX wet (plugin only, not on the hardware). Off, the default: the hardware's routing, the effect at full level with the reverb added (Rev mix). On: fully wet. FX → Rev plays only the reverb of the effect (delay and echo keep their repeats); Rev → FX plays only the effect of the reverb.
keys.L ↔ R: Pan left to right and back (era 5), once per cycle.

areas.meter_in: Input meter. Click CLIP to clear.
areas.meter_out: Output meter. Click CLIP to clear.
areas.wet_stereo: Wet input: L+R summed, as the hardware.
areas.eqgraph: Drag a square to set frequency and gain.

overlay.Native rate: Run at the era's own sample rate.
overlay.Eco (host rate): Run at the host rate. Lighter on CPU.
overlay.Random: Different hiss and dither per instance.
overlay.Per era: Each era keeps its own settings.
overlay.Trem. DM: FX A/B: tremolo adds a small delay sweep.
overlay.Store as: Save as a new user preset.
overlay.Export: Export the preset to a file.
